description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseResponse' used by API response classes in the Microsoft.eShopWeb.PublicApi namespace. It inherits from 'BaseMessage' and provides constructors to initialize correlation identifiers.

classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for API response objects, providing correlation ID handling.
